newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Senate moves on to budget bills.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Senate moves on to budget bills.

text.p: The Australian Senate began debate on the contentious budget bills at around 0100 GMT (12.00 noon) after passing an uncontentious tax bill.
The Senate moved to the main debating stage (the second reading) of two bills to tighten social security entitlements.
Assuming the bills survive the second reading vote, they will go into the Senate's amendment mode (the committee of the whole) where at least one of the key independents is expected to want changes.
Contentious measures in the two bills, for which the government will probably need the two independents for passage, are worth A$336 million in 1997/98, their first full year of operation.
